observations: Photo 0 shows a close-up of a sewing machine's control panel.
The panel has a black background with red trim and text 'EM81' in red.
There is a black knob with a red ring, likely for speed or stitch selection.
The machine body is off-white or cream-colored with some visible wear and dust.
A watermark 'NATHANZ SEWING EQUIPMENT' is overlaid on the image.
No full view of the machine, no power cord, no needle area, no motor housing, no control panel buttons or dials.
No visible brand logo or model name beyond 'EM81'.

claims.claim: Direct drive emel industrial sewing machine
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'EM81' on the panel, but no visible proof of 'direct drive' or 'emel' brand. The term 'emel' is not readable on the machine in the photo.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not be a genuine 'emel' brand or may not be 'direct drive' as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the brand logo or model name on the machine, preferably on the motor housing or control panel.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic industrial sewing machine, not as an emel direct drive model

risks.risk: The machine may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., motor not working, missing parts).
risks.proof: A full 360-degree photo of the machine showing all sides, including the needle area, motor housing, power cord, and control panel.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or with unknown functionality

risks.risk: The machine may be missing accessories (e.g., foot pedal, power cord, bobbins, needles).
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the machine.

proof_requests: Close-up of the sticker with the model number, usually on the motor or inside the door.
A clear photo of the brand logo or model name on the machine.
A full 360-degree photo of the machine showing all sides, including the needle area and motor housing.
A photo of all included accessories (power cord, foot pedal, bobbins, needles, etc.).
A video or photo showing the machine in operation, if possible.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
